articles.summary: BRISBANE, Calif., March 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Vera Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: VERA) today announced that, on March 23, 2026, the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors (Compensation Committee) of Vera Therapeutics granted inducement awards consisting of non-qualified stock options
articles.title: Vera Therapeutics Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
